description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the Gitlab OAuth2 Provider implementation, validating URL generation, token retrieval, user data fetching, and error handling methods.

classes.name: GitlabTest
classes.description: Test suite for the Gitlab OAuth2 provider, testing URL generation, token exchange, user info retrieval, error handling, and API client access.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the Gitlab provider instance with mock client ID, secret, and redirect URI.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up mock objects after each test.

methods.name: testShorthandedSelfhostedConstructor
methods.description: Tests constructor behavior when specifying a custom Gitlab domain for self-hosted instances.

methods.name: testAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Verifies that the authorization URL contains expected query parameters.

methods.name: testScopes
methods.description: Checks that scopes are correctly encoded into the URL.

methods.name: testGetAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Validates that the authorization URL path is correct.

methods.name: testGetBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Asserts that the access token URL path is correctly returned.

methods.name: testGetAccessToken
methods.description: Mocks token response and tests token retrieval logic.

methods.name: testSelfHostedGitlabDomainUrls
methods.description: Tests URL generation and token exchange for a self-hosted Gitlab domain.

methods.name: testUserData
methods.description: Mocks user data response and verifies resource owner creation and data mapping.

methods.name: testApiClient
methods.description: Ensures the resource owner can instantiate the correct API client.

methods.name: testExceptionThrownWhenErrorObjectReceived
methods.description: Checks that proper exception is raised when error object is returned in token response.

methods.name: testExceptionThrownWhenOAuthErrorReceived
methods.description: Verifies that an exception is thrown on OAuth error response.
